name: Mem_BitmapPool_Init
signature: void* Mem_BitmapPool_Init(MemPool* self, unsigned blockSize, unsigned blockCount, void* allocator)
summary: Initialises a pool object: self[0..2] become a circular free-list head, a global single instance is created once (guarded by the byte at 0x007BE37C) by allocating a bitmap plus block area, and the pool parameters are stored at +0xc/+0x10/+0x14. The three init-time callers register one pool per engine object type.
evidence: Body 0x57010C-0x570298: str r0,[r0]/[r0+4]/[r0+8] ring init; guarded call at 0x570240 to 0x0011CFAC (SDK heap alloc, size rounded with +0xf/&~0xf); globals 0x007BE37C/0x007BE380/0x00837128; literal 0x00782AC0 written as object tag. The rest of the 8892-byte Ghidra range (0x5702CC+) is a table of 226 tiny type predicates (see 0x5723C8), not part of this function.

name: maybe_Script_CheckObjectTypeId
summary: One of ~226 identical 44-byte predicates: returns 1 when scriptValue[1] == 1 and scriptValue[2] carries that class's hard-coded 32-bit id, else 0. Looks like the script-binding type check for a native class; exact class unknown because the Ghidra "function" is the whole table.
evidence: 0x5723CC: ldr r1,[r0,#4]; cmp r1,#1; ldr r0,[r0,#8]; ldr r1,[pc,...]; cmp; moveq r0,#1; bx lr. Repeats every 0x2C bytes from 0x5702CC to 0x572978 (226 copies), each with a different constant (0x4D4F2BE8, 0x0731F3E8, ...). Entry-point export marks the region as one Thumb function, so decomp/readable C is garbage.

name: Math_ComputeBoundingSphere
signature: void Math_ComputeBoundingSphere(float* outSphere, unsigned count, const void* points, unsigned stride)
summary: Computes the minimum enclosing sphere of a strided point array and writes centre xyz + radius. It copies the point addresses into an on-stack pointer array and delegates to the Welzl solver at 0x5737A4, so callers get the same result as the recursive routine with an empty boundary set.
evidence: out[0..3] initialised from 0x007E71BC (zero vec4, BSS); loop stores `arg3 + i*arg4` (point pointers) into a stack array; tail call func_005737A4(array, arrayBase, count, 0). Caller 0x58D5E8 uses the result for a scene-entry bounding sphere.

name: Math_MinimumEnclosingSphere
signature: void Math_MinimumEnclosingSphere(float* outSphere, void** points, unsigned count, int boundaryCount)
summary: Welzl-style minimum enclosing sphere: for boundary sizes 1..4 it builds the sphere through those support points (point, midpoint, circumcircle, circumsphere) and otherwise recursively tries each remaining point as a boundary point. Output is xyz + radius.
evidence: switch(arg4) cases 0-4: case 1 copies one point with radius 0; case 2 calls 0x574DE4 (two-point midpoint, radius in [3]); case 3 calls 0x574E48 (circumcircle of 3 points); case 4 calls 0x57505C (circumsphere of 4). The loop rotates the candidate list and recurses with boundaryCount+1 - exactly the move-to-front Welzl algorithm.

name: Math_ComputePrincipalAxesQuaternion
signature: void Math_ComputePrincipalAxesQuaternion(float* outQuat, void* matrixScratch, const float* diagonal, const float* offDiagonal)
summary: Turns six covariance terms (xx,yy,zz and xy,yz,zx) into an orientation: the helpers at 0x574CE8/0x574774/0x574A20 fill a 3x3 frame and the tail extracts a normalised quaternion with the trace/off-diagonal formulas. Used by the OBB builder at 0x575A40.
evidence: Entry preloads 6 floats from r2/r3, calls 0x574CE8, 0x574774, 0x574A20 with the 0x40-byte scratch object, then 0x574C3C does s0 = trace + 1.0; sqrt; 1/(2*sqrt) scaling, and writes 4 normalised floats (w = 0.5*sqrt(1+trace)). Caller 0x575A40 passes the covariance accumulators.

name: Math_SphereFromThreePoints
signature: float* Math_SphereFromThreePoints(float* outSphere, const float* a, const float* b, const float* c)
summary: Circumscribed circle of three points in 3D: returns centre xyz plus radius (out[3]). Collinear/degenerate input falls back to the longest of the three edges so the result stays finite.
evidence: u=b-a, v=c-a, cross; if |cross|^2 <= eps handles collinear by halving the longer edge; otherwise centre = a + (|v|^2 (u x w) + |u|^2 (w x v)) / (2|cross|^2). out[3] = |centre-a|. Constants 0.0/1.0/0.5 at 0x575050/54/58. Called by the Welzl solver for boundaryCount==3.

name: Math_SphereFromFourPoints
signature: float* Math_SphereFromFourPoints(float* outSphere, const float* a, const float* b, const float* c, const float* d)
summary: Circumscribed sphere of four points (centre xyz + radius). Degenerate/coplanar input is reduced to the best three-point sphere via 0x574E48, matching the fallback ladder of the Welzl solver.
evidence: Computes the 3x3 determinant (scalar triple product) of the edge vectors in fVar10; if non-zero the centre is the standard barycentric solution with 1/(2*det); otherwise tries the four 3-point subsets through 0x574E48 and picks the smallest. Called by 0x5737A4 for boundaryCount==4.

name: Math_BuildRotYQuaternion
summary: Builds a quaternion for a rotation about the Y axis. The angle is normalised to a full turn and halved (0x6731EC = wrap, 0x672E44 = cos), giving (0, sin(theta/2), 0, cos(theta/2)) with the correct sign for the second half-turn.
evidence: Writes out[0]=0, out[1]=+/-sqrt(1-c^2), out[2]=0, out[3]=c. Literals 0x5759F0=2pi, 0x5759F4=0.5, 0x5759F8=1.0, 0x5759FC=pi. The 0.5 factor is the half-angle used by quaternions; the compare against pi bit-pattern flips the sine sign.

name: Math_ComputeObbFromPoints
signature: void Math_ComputeObbFromPoints(float* outObb, unsigned count, const void* points, unsigned stride)
summary: Fits an oriented bounding box to a strided point array: centroid, 3x3 covariance, principal-axis quaternion (0x574B10), quaternion->matrix (0x57600C), then min/max extents in that frame. Writes quaternion (4), centre (3) and half-extents (3).
evidence: Averages all points (fVar14=1/count), accumulates xx/yy/zz/xy/yz/zx, calls 0x574B10(&quat,&scratch,&diag,&offdiag), 0x57600C (quat->matrix) and 0x574548 (matrix*vector); output arg1[0..3]=quat, [4..6]=centre, [7..9]=extents. Default 10-float value in 0x0075?e24. Called by 0x58D5E8 for scene entries.

name: Math_BuildRotYMatrix
summary: Fills a 3x4 rotation matrix for a rotation about Y: cos on [0]/[10], +/-sin on [2]/[8], 1.0 on [5], zeros elsewhere. The angle is wrapped to one full turn first.
evidence: out[0]=c, out[10]=c, out[8]=-s, out[2]=+s, out[5]=1.0; constants 0x575F58=2pi, 0x575F5C=1.0, 0x575F60=pi, 0x575F64=0.0. Same wrap+cos/sqrt(1-c^2) pattern as 0x575984.

name: Math_BuildRotZMatrix
summary: Fills a 3x4 rotation matrix for a rotation about Z: [0]=c, [5]=c, [1]=-s, [4]=+s, [10]=1.0. Used by the model/animation code to build joint frames.
evidence: Writes c at [0] and [5], +/-sqrt(1-c^2) at [1]/[4], 1.0 at [10]; constants 0x575FFC=2pi, 0x576000=1.0, 0x576004=pi, 0x576008=0.0. Same angle-wrap helper 0x6731EC / 0x672E44 as the Y variant.

name: Script_GetVmOrThrow
summary: Checks the low tag bit of a script value; if it is not set the engine error handler (0x0010009C) is called with the empty format string at 0x7C087C, otherwise the global Squirrel VM pointer at 0x0083876C is returned. Effectively "get the VM for this closure, asserting the value is a closure".

name: Script_Closure_Destroy
summary: Destructor for a script closure/thread wrapper: installs vtable 0x00782690, and when the initialised flag at +0x10 is set releases the VM child object through the Squirrel VM helpers 0x6BD10C/0x6BD12C and clears the flag.

name: Container_List_Init

name: maybe_Script_ReleaseCallback

name: Serializer_ReadVarUInt
signature: unsigned Serializer_ReadVarUInt(Stream* stream, unsigned unusedArg2, unsigned unusedArg3, unsigned defaultValue)
summary: Reads a variable-length unsigned integer from a virtual stream: one byte, and if it is >= 0x80 the number of extra bytes comes from the nibble-indexed table at 0x0079?EEC, then the remaining bytes are shifted in 8 bits at a time. Returns 0 on short read.

name: maybe_Gfx_Node_DestroyChildren
summary: Virtual teardown slot for a scene-graph node: asks the node for its child list (vtable+0xc) and then releases the list (vtable+0x10). Ghidra could not recover the indirect jump at 0x57A00C but the two calls are enough to identify the role.

name: Gfx_ModelInstance_ApplyEnvParams
signature: void Gfx_ModelInstance_ApplyEnvParams(GfxModelInstance* self, const float* envParams, const float* cameraBasis)
summary: Per-frame environment update for a model instance: copies 12 floats of light/colour parameters into +0xa8..+0xd4 (or combines them with the instance matrix when flag bit0 of +0x164 is set), rebuilds a billboard frame and forwards it to the effect emitter 0x532F44, then computes a distance-based colour/alpha scale into +0xd8.

Calls 0x00532F44 (maybe_Fx_Billboard_EmitList) with &self->f_34 when the camera flag bits say so. Distance factor uses 0x0057A268 (1.0), 0x0057AB3C/40/44. Referenced from vtable 0x7828C4 slot 0x14.

summary: Refreshes the cached per-part axis-aligned bounds of a model instance. For each node it either derives the AABB from the node frame (when the model has an unskinned part table) or unions the child AABBs, then clears the "bounds dirty" bit 2 of +0x164.

name: Gfx_ModelInstance_UpdateDistanceFade
signature: void Gfx_ModelInstance_UpdateDistanceFade(GfxModelInstance* self, const Camera* camera, const GfxViewport* viewport)
summary: Computes the distance-based fade/scale factor for a model instance from the camera and viewport matrices and multiplies the instance's per-part fade array by it. Base value uses the projection row and viewport height; parts listed in the instance fade table are scaled in place.

Data refs 0x7828B4 (vtable slot 0) and 0x7828C4 region; vtable 0x7828B4 slots are the model-instance methods 0x57C570/0x57B0EC/0x57BFF4/...

name: Gfx_ModelInstance_InitDefaults

name: maybe_Gfx_SceneNode_InitFromEntry

name: maybe_Gfx_SceneMesh_IntersectBlock1

Disassembly shows matrix/vector math and calls to 0x573100, 0x574440, 0x574548 and 0x575A04 inside the scene-mesh intersection cluster, so it is a continuation block of that code rather than a standalone function. Role unverified.

Neighbours 0x584C70 (maybe_Gfx_Scene_WalkNodesAndIntersectB) and the 0x574xxx geometry helpers bound the region. No data references to 0x585C18.

name: Gfx_Scene_AllocEntryFromBitmap
summary: Allocates a free scene-entry slot: scans the inverted allocation bitmap in the scene object, marks the first free bit, computes the entry address from the slot stride 0x9c and initialises it either from the resource descriptor (0x58D5E8) or from its inline grid data (0x58D42C). name: maybe_Gfx_Scene_GridMarkBits

summary: Main mesh builder for scene entries: resolves the descriptor, optionally compacts unused vertices into a smaller index buffer, allocates the vertex/index block from the scene allocator, remaps indices, transforms points when a transform function is supplied and computes bounding sphere (0x573600), AABB/OBB (0x573F48, 0x575A40) and the name hash.
